title: Wonder Upon Wonder
story: A Marvellous Work and a Wonder
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The storm has passed, the clouds pull back,
And colors fill the air;
I never made a single stripe —
But look, the bow is there.

[Chorus]
A marvellous work and wonder,
More than my eyes can hold;
He does such good and clever things,
And never once grows old.

[Verse 2]
How does He do it? Scout looked up
With both eyes open wide;
The whole sky wore a shining arch
From this to that far side.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
A brand-new baby's tiny hand,
A kindness like a song,
A morning full of quiet light —
His wonders all day long.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
The bow is gone, the stars come out —
Another wonder shown;
Lie still and let Him hold the sky,
You never watch alone.

[Chorus]
mood: Looking-up music. Each line starts low and opens upward, the way a child's head tips back to follow a rainbow from one end of the sky to the other, then settles down again at the close. A small harp turning slow arpeggios under the voice, one long low cello note underneath so the wonder has a floor to stand on. It should sound like being quietly amazed rather than excited, each verse arriving a little more settled than the one before.
